rules.title: Apply for determination of the online game
actions: Identify whether the game is offered as an e-sport, falls under a notified social-game category, or is subject to suo motu determination
Apply to the Authority in the prescribed digital form with details under Rule 23
rules.penaltyBasis: Offering an online game without required determination

rules.title: Furnish technical and revenue-model details for examination
actions: Disclose technical architecture, gameplay mechanics, user interface and revenue model
Disclose whether fees, deposits or stakes carry an expectation of monetary winnings
rules.penaltyBasis: Furnishing incomplete or incorrect determination details

rules.title: Report payment-facilitation changes after determination
actions: Notify the Authority of any change affecting facilitation of payments before offering it
rules.penaltyBasis: Failure to report changes requiring fresh determination

rules.title: Apply to register each online game
actions: File a separate registration application for each online game in the digital form
Confirm online money games are not submitted for registration as e-sports
rules.penaltyBasis: Offering a game that requires registration without registering

rules.title: Obtain and retain the Certificate of Registration
actions: Obtain the digital Certificate of Registration with a unique registration number
Track validity (up to ten years) and surrender, suspension or cancellation status
rules.penaltyBasis: Operating without a valid Certificate of Registration

rules.title: Display registration and avoid misrepresentation
actions: Prominently display determination or registration details on the game's computer resource
Do not misrepresent, advertise or offer the game contrary to its determined or registered status
rules.penaltyBasis: Misrepresentation of determination or registration status

rules.title: Designate a point of contact
actions: Designate personnel as point of contact and publish their contact details per directions
rules.penaltyBasis: Failure to designate and publish a point of contact

rules.title: Retain traffic data and metadata in India
actions: Retain and store traffic data, metadata and related information on computer resources located in India per directions
rules.penaltyBasis: Non-compliance with data retention and localisation directions

rules.title: Comply with financial-transaction and fund directions
actions: Ensure facilitation, routing and settlement of user payments comply with directions
Enable verification of the determination order or Certificate of Registration before fund facilitation
rules.penaltyBasis: Non-compliance with financial-transaction and fund directions

rules.title: Operate a grievance redressal mechanism
actions: Establish and maintain a functional grievance redressal mechanism for users
Resolve grievances and enable escalation to the Authority within thirty days
rules.penaltyBasis: Failure to maintain a functional grievance redressal mechanism

rules.title: Provide user safety features
actions: Implement age verification or age-gating, time restrictions and parental controls
Provide user reporting, counselling support and fair-play and integrity monitoring tools

rules.title: Respond to the Authority's non-compliance notice
actions: Respond to the notice of alleged non-compliance and appear before the Authority
Show cause or record any admission within the proceedings
rules.penaltyBasis: Contravention of directions or orders under Section 8(3)

rules.title: Remediate and pay any penalty imposed
actions: Implement corrective and remedial measures specified in the order
Pay any penalty imposed under Section 12, credited to the Consolidated Fund of India
rules.penaltyBasis: Failure to remediate or pay penalty; risk of registration suspension or prohibition

rules.title: File an appeal where aggrieved
actions: File an appeal to the Appellate Authority within thirty days of the order
rules.penaltyBasis: Loss of appellate remedy if not filed within thirty days
